correctness.rationale: The exact four-part face decomposition follows by center membership. The three-term core is a union of three contractible complexes attached along contractible simplicial intersections; quotienting it produces a double suspension of a uniform simplex skeleton, or a circle at r=2. The all-r integral chain calculation identifies H with the appropriate exterior power of the augmentation lattice and a center-swap sign. The standalone exact mod-two and Lefschetz checker verified 54 cases and 892 group actions, independently supplementing the general proof.

value.rationale: The 2020 problem asks for precise sphere multiplicities of higher-independence complexes of trees. The first two-branched-center family has a complete, nontrivial binomial multiplicity and one-degree-at-a-time filtration, unexpectedly independent of branch imbalance. Its integral full-automorphism representation and center-exchange sign provide natural information not implied by vertex decomposability or mere wedge existence. The result is an exact natural family classification, not an arbitrary finite recomputation.
